Bakery

What the Bakehouse offers

From the photos, the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Pastries and bread

Guests praise the choice of pastries, freshly baked. 4 reviews mention the choice, 2 the savouries, 2 the rolls.

Cakes

9 reviews mention the cakes. One guest thanks the bakery for the birthday cakes.

Specialty coffee

14 reviews mention the coffee. The Instagram profile promises freshly roasted beans, and orders also go through Wolt.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Lovely staff

4 Google reviews mention the lovely staff, 2 the smile. One guest writes that the family makes you feel very welcome.

Breakfast and lunch

One guest came for breakfast and lunch and was not disappointed.

Coming back

One visitor goes every time they are in Cyprus. Another calls it one of the best bakeries in Cyprus.

On Meropis

At Meropis 9 in Larnaca, the shop with the white sign that says est. 1990. Open Monday to Friday 7:30-17:00, Saturday and Sunday closed. Phone 24 638022.
